function zIndexCase(variant) {
  const checks = {}, n = variant + 5;
  const parent = document.createElement('div');
  parent.style.cssText = 'position:relative;width:120px;height:90px;z-index:' + n;
  const child = document.createElement('div');
  child.style.cssText = 'width:40px;height:30px';
  parent.appendChild(child);
  document.body.appendChild(parent);
  const value = element => getComputedStyle(element).zIndex;
  checks.initial = value(child) === 'auto';
  checks.integer = value(parent) === String(n);
  checks.notInherited = value(child) === 'auto';
  child.style.zIndex = 'inherit';
  checks.inherit = value(child) === String(n);
  parent.style.zIndex = String(n + 1);
  checks.liveInheritance = value(child) === String(n + 1);
  child.style.zIndex = 'unset';
  checks.unset = value(child) === 'auto';
  child.style.zIndex = 'initial';
  checks.initialKeyword = value(child) === 'auto';
  child.style.zIndex = String(-n);
  checks.negative = value(child) === String(-n);
  checks.staticInteger = getComputedStyle(child).position === 'static' && value(child) === String(-n);
  child.style.setProperty('--level', String(n + 3));
  child.style.zIndex = 'var(--level)';
  checks.variable = value(child) === String(n + 3);
  child.style.setProperty('--level', String(n + 4));
  checks.variableMutation = value(child) === String(n + 4);
  child.style.zIndex = 'var(--missing, auto)';
  checks.fallback = value(child) === 'auto';
  child.style.zIndex = 'calc(2.5)';
  checks.positiveTie = value(child) === '3';
  child.style.zIndex = 'calc(-2.5)';
  checks.negativeTie = value(child) === '-2';
  child.style.zIndex = 'calc(2 * 3 + 1)';
  checks.arithmetic = value(child) === '7';
  child.style.zIndex = 'min(9, 4)';
  checks.minimum = value(child) === '4';
  child.style.zIndex = 'max(-9, -4)';
  checks.maximum = value(child) === '-4';
  child.style.zIndex = 'clamp(2, 5, 8)';
  checks.clamp = value(child) === '5';
  child.style.zIndex = String(n);
  child.style.zIndex = '1.5';
  checks.invalidFloat = value(child) === String(n);
  child.style.zIndex = '12px';
  checks.invalidLength = value(child) === String(n);
  child.style.zIndex = 'banana';
  checks.invalidKeyword = value(child) === String(n);
  child.style.zIndex = '-0';
  checks.zero = value(child) === '0';
  child.style.zIndex = '+0012';
  checks.canonicalInteger = value(child) === '12';
  child.style.zIndex = '2147483647';
  checks.upperBound = value(child) === '2147483647';
  child.style.zIndex = '-2147483647';
  checks.lowerBound = value(child) === '-2147483647';
  const before = child.getBoundingClientRect();
  child.style.zIndex = '999';
  const after = child.getBoundingClientRect();
  checks.geometry = before.x === after.x && before.y === after.y && before.width === after.width && before.height === after.height;
  for (const position of ['relative', 'absolute', 'fixed', 'sticky']) {
    child.style.cssText = 'position:' + position + ';top:0;left:0;width:40px;height:30px;z-index:' + n;
    checks[position] = value(child) === String(n) && child.getBoundingClientRect().width === 40;
  }
  child.id = 'external';
  child.style.cssText = 'position:relative;width:40px;height:30px;z-index:' + n;
  checks.externalImportant = value(child) === '29';
  child.style.setProperty('z-index', String(n + 10), 'important');
  checks.inlineImportant = value(child) === String(n + 10);
  child.style.removeProperty('z-index');
  checks.removeInline = value(child) === '29';
  document.querySelector('link').remove();
  checks.removeStylesheet = value(child) === 'auto';
  child.style.setProperty('z-index', String(n));
  checks.propertyRead = child.style.getPropertyValue('z-index') === String(n);
  checks.supportsInteger = CSS.supports('z-index', String(n));
  checks.supportsCalc = CSS.supports('z-index', 'calc(-2.5)');
  checks.rejectsFloat = !CSS.supports('z-index', '1.5');
  const detached = document.createElement('div');
  detached.style.zIndex = '20';
  checks.detached = getComputedStyle(detached).zIndex === '';
  return checks;
}
